newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in Citic Pacific shrs suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Citic Pacific shrs suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Citic Pacific Ltd was suspended, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
Trading was suspended on the company's request, an exchange spokesman said.
A CITIC Pacific spokeswoman declined to comment on the suspension but said a statement was expected later on Tuesday.
CITIC Pacific shares stood at HK$39.50 at Tuesday's open before trading was suspended, unchanged from Monday, with a total of 27,000 shares changing hands.
